```{r}
### set up assessments
tbl_diag <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select(contains("moca"), visit_id, -moca_total_1, -ends_with("_1") ) %>% 
  collect
### set up demographics
tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id, csa_id, race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
### get name of assessments
diag_name<- data.frame(colnames(tbl_diag))
```
###moca clean up
```{r}
#1260
moca_a <- tbl_diag %>% 
  select(moca_abstraction,moca_attention, moca_language, moca_memory, moca_naming, moca_orientation, moca_recall, moca_source, moca_total, moca_visuospatial, 
         visit_id) %>% 
  drop_na()

#93
moca_l <- tbl_diag %>% 
  select(-c(moca_abstraction,moca_attention, moca_language, moca_memory, moca_naming, moca_orientation, moca_recall, moca_source, moca_total, moca_visuospatial), visit_id ) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(starts_with("moca"), is.na))


```





###demographics clean up
```{r}
# set up/ data cleaning from exp_diag
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age)) %>% 
  select(-c(ptid, csa_id, shape, shape_num))
```
### checking work
```{r}
sim <- intersect( moca_l$visit_id, moca_a$visit_id)

sim <- c(sim[0:11])
moca_l[moca_l$visit_id %in% sim,] %>% View
```

check_a<-moca_a %>% select(-c(visit_id, moca_total))

```

```


### rm "88 = Not applicable", and make numeric
```{r}
moca_l <- moca_l %>%
  mutate(mocarecc = ifelse(mocarecc ==  "88 = Not applicable", NA, mocarecc),
         mocarecr = ifelse(mocarecr ==  "88 = Not applicable", NA, mocarecr))
```

```{r}
moca_l_compute <- moca_l %>% 
  select(-c(mocareas, mocaloc, mocalan, mocavis, mocahear)) %>% 
  mutate(across(-visit_id, ~ as.numeric(.)))
```

### compare 
```{r}
colSums(is.na(moca_l))
colSums(is.na(moca_l_compute))
```

### adding moca scores
```{r}
moca_l_specialized <- moca_l_compute %>% 
  mutate(moca_abstraction = mocaabst, 
         moca_attention = rowSums(across(c(mocadigi, mocalett, mocaser7)),  na.rm = T),
         moca_language = rowSums(across(c(mocarepe,  mocaflue)),  na.rm = T),
         moca_memory = mocaregi,
         moca_naming = rowSums(across(mocanami),  na.rm = T),
         moca_orientation = rowSums(across(c(mocaordt, mocaormo, mocaoryr, mocaordy, mocaorpl, mocaorct)),  na.rm = T),
         moca_recall = rowSums(across(c(mocarecn, mocarecc, mocarecr)),  na.rm = T), 
         moca_source = "small" ,
         moca_total = rowSums(across( c(mocatrai, mocacube, mocacloc, mocaclon, mocacloh,  mocarecn, mocarecc, mocarecr, mocaordt,
           mocaormo, mocaoryr, mocaordy, mocaorpl, mocaorct, mocanami, mocarepe, mocaflue, mocadigi, mocalett, mocaser7)),  na.rm = T), 
         moca_visuospatial = rowSums(across(c(mocatrai, mocacube, mocacloc, mocaclon, mocacloh)),  na.rm = T), 
         visit_id = visit_id
  ) 
moca_l_specialized <- moca_l_specialized%>% 
  select(c(moca_abstraction, moca_attention, moca_language, moca_memory, moca_naming, moca_orientation, moca_recall, moca_source, moca_total,
           moca_visuospatial, visit_id))
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(moca_l_specialized))
```

```{r}
lapply(moca_l_specialized, unique)
```


###combining tables 
```{r}
moca_a_demo <- rbind(moca_a, moca_l_specialized)

moca_total <- inner_join(moca_a_demo, demographics, by = "visit_id")%>% 
  select(-c(diagnosis, medicaid)) %>% 
  mutate(
    health_status = case_when(
      further_diag == "HC" ~ "HC",
      further_diag =="AD" ~ "AD",
      .default = "other cases")
)
moca_total <- moca_total %>%
  mutate(across(-c(visit_id, moca_source, visit_type, visit_date, new_id, further_diag, health_status, eth, race, gender), ~ as.numeric(.)))
  
```
```{r}
lapply(moca_total, unique)
```

### demographics
```{r}
no_id <- moca_total %>% 
  select(-c(visit_id,visit_date, num_diagnosis, new_id)) 
  
```

```{r}
table_1 <- tbl_summary(
  no_id,
  by = further_diag,
  type = list(where(is.numeric) ~ "continuous"),
  list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
  label = c(list(race = "Race"), 
            list(eth = "Ethnicity"), 
            list(age_group = "Age"), 
            list(gender = "Gender"), 
            list(medicaid = "Medicaid")),
  missing_text = "Missing Values") %>% 
  as_gt()

table_1
```
```{r}
gt::gtsave(table_1, filename = "moca_demo.html")
```

### total v source v health
```{r}
no_id %>% ggplot(aes(x = moca_total, fill = moca_source)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "count")+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(health_status), scales = "free") 
```

### contingency tables 
```{r}
vars <- setdiff(names(no_id), "moca_source")
tables <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  table(no_id[[v]])
})

tables
```
### correlation matrix:

```{r}

correlation <- no_id %>% 
  select(-c(race, eth, moca_source, visit_type, further_diag, health_status, gender))
no_id.cor = cor(correlation , use="complete.obs", method = c("spearman"))

corrplot(no_id.cor)
```
